Alyssa — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we heard: Quantix is evaluating inference providers to reduce per-token cost for your personalization pipeline while keeping tail latency under 150ms for 99th percentile. Security (VPC + KMS) and a short pilot that preserves PII controls are must-haves.
- Recommended starting pilot: 2-week reserved capacity trial on a 2-node Dedicated pool with our latency SLOs + prefix caching.
- Success criteria: (1) <40% token cost reduction vs current provider on production traces, (2) p99 latency <150ms for personalized requests, (3) no production data exfiltration risk per your security checklist.

Owner / next steps: 
- Redwood (me): share discovery notes, pilot estimate, and a short runbook for onboarding — attached. [attachment: discovery-notes-quantix.pdf (pdf)]
- Quantix (Alyssa + procurement): confirm pilot budget and procurement path; proposed start week of Oct 11.
- Timeline check: if Q4 priorities shift we can postpone the pilot to Nov.

Can you confirm the preferred procurement contact and whether Oct 11 still looks doable? If helpful, I can book a 15-min alignment call next week.

Thanks,

— Priyom
